https://github.com/programmingkenta/project_002/tree/c1011b5169c0b53371a27c851125aa933684177e
File: shibuya_lod2.html. Application code from that project is not included.

Source snapshot: 2026-02-05T08:58:07Z
The transformed road excerpt is distributed as shibuyaRoads in shibuya-data.js under ODbL.

Rail alignments: the same public extraction, sourced there from MLIT Shibuya related railway open data.

Processing for Neil Pai's portfolio: building bases flattened per building, coordinates rounded to centimetres, road segments clipped to 242 m, arrays compacted. Facades, signage, lighting, crossing paint, people and a contemporary station tower are added interpretations. No photographic building textures are redistributed. This is not an official map or a current survey.
